gaps.sentence: He ordered ___ steak, but it arrived cold.
gaps.explanation: 'A steak' first, then 'the waiter' — the restaurant's waiter, definite in context.

gaps.sentence: ___ Alps attract skiers from all over the world.
gaps.explanation: Mountain ranges take 'the' (the Alps), but single peaks take no article (Everest).

gaps.sentence: We visited ___ Louvre on our last morning in Paris.
gaps.explanation: Most famous buildings and monuments take 'the': the Louvre, the Eiffel Tower.

gaps.sentence: ___ unemployment has fallen sharply this year.
gaps.explanation: Unemployment as a general concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: He earns fifty thousand pounds ___ year.
gaps.explanation: 'Fifty thousand a year' — 'a' = per in rates.

gaps.sentence: ___ Himalayas are among the youngest mountains on Earth.
gaps.explanation: Ranges like 'the Himalayas' take 'the'; single peaks take no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ young woman at reception speaks five languages.
gaps.explanation: 'The young woman at reception' — defined by the location phrase.

gaps.sentence: She goes to ___ school by bus every morning.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to school/work/bed/church' (as participant) takes no article.
